items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Ray Happen used to play drum with him

ctx.x: And who did he have in his band Robichaud? Hardest remember
But he had old good musicians Ray Happen used to play drum with him And Black Benny All them different fellas Well now it's been so long I have forgot a whole lot of them
What was the very first job you ever played? Can you remember that you got paid for it? Well, the first job
